lead: The published gate report (bc-corridors-85, 2026-09-12) is retained below as the coordinated baseline; the sections above it are measured on the current model on every refresh. Nothing here qualifies structure, slabs, vehicles or traffic.

basis.method: Continuous sweep bounded by adaptive poses and added allowance; oriented component envelopes. Full assembled geometry is screened regardless of display filters. No dynamic stability, braking, slab capacity or operating approval.

routes.label: Plant perimeter logistics circuit
routes.note: Proposed receiving/dispatch circulation outside process bays and remote retention tanks. Requires site-boundary and new slab qualification; it is not an existing approved roadway.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: A-100 / A-140 / A-160 delivery frontage
routes.note: Frontage staging only. Individual unloading interfaces and pedestrian crossings require an operating plan.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Preview assumes pedestrian access is closed and the engineer animation is stopped. Real use requires a separated pedestrian route where practicable, or an engineered closure/control arrangement under WorkSafeBC 16.6. This preview does not operate physical gates.

routes.label: A-5000 east service approach
routes.note: Connects west delivery frontage to the north logistics corridor. Controlled reversing at delivery stops; no lifting beneath utilities.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: A-6000 approach → right turn → service aisle
routes.note: Approach north on the west frontage, turn right into the cross-aisle, continue east and stop before the distribution risers. The turn starts at X32 / Z39.5 and ends at X35.5 / Z36 with the 3.5 m planning radius. This is a forklift route; bulk supplier unloading and the return manoeuvre are separate studies.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: A-300 → A-1000 under-rack aisle
routes.note: Approach from the open space east of A-300, turn right and continue beneath the shared services along the A-1000 frontage. Stop at X52 / Z2.6. The entrance is offset from the existing wash-service columns and low filtration piping. The complete truck/load envelope is reserved before rack placement; pipe endpoints, gravity slopes and equipment legs remain fixed. One-way access preview; loading and return movements remain unqualified.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: Receiving → A-100 delivery frontage
routes.note: Proposed receiving transfer via the reserved west corridor to raw-material staging. Stops at the frontage; dock interfaces, unloading and the return manoeuvre are not modeled.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Preview assumes pedestrian access is closed and the engineer animation is stopped. Real use requires a separated pedestrian route where practicable, or an engineered closure/control arrangement under WorkSafeBC 16.6. This preview does not operate physical gates.

routes.label: A-800 east frontage → north dispatch
routes.note: Proposed outward transfer along the reserved east and north perimeter. Starts outside A-800; equipment pickup, dispatch bays, site boundary and slab capacity still require confirmation.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

findings.action: Revise the A-2000 RO / UF permeate rack tiers and the A-4000 header brackets so each held line has a bearing corridor; record the rack revision in the model before support calculations start.

findings.topic: Model catch-up release 1 (D-MDL-01): retired tags kept in place, A-1000 / A-2000 tanks at datasheet volumes
findings.status: Applied to the model — removal handed to the model engineer
findings.observation: D-MDL-01 (bases MC-1–MC-10, approved by QFL 2026-09-28) brings the model in line with the V219–V227 data-layer decisions. Release 1 keeps the 21 retired A-1000 / A-2000 tags in place — shown grey and labelled RETIRED with their decision — because the model engineer's validators still assert their streams, and resizes the A-1000 / A-2000 tanks to the issued datasheets (T-1006 400 m³ at Ø 8.4 m, R-1001 25, R-1002 30, R-1003 16, R-1004 10, T-1002 80, T-1003 30, T-1008 12, T-2001 15, T-2002 100 m³). Against main, on A-1000 / A-2000: pipe-support holds 229 → 230, structure passes, no headroom conflict, and two more reserved-space entries on an existing class in the containment yard (BND-1004 / TR-perimeter-85); R-1002 / R-1003 / R-1004 keep their footprints because new diameters re-flowed rack supports into emergency walkways PW-ES-030 / 031. Current model: 287 holds plant-wide. C-301 and T-304 (release 2) sit behind the pipe-racks-v31 fixture, which already fails on main.

findings.topic: A-1000 south strip cleared (D-MDL-03): retired equipment removed, interarea lines re-routed, CL-1001 and SL-1001 inside A-1000
findings.observation: Correction to the release-3 record (A1000-17, LAY-11 and the hand-off note, 2026-09-29): CL-1001 at (76.5, −42.5) was ≈ 44 m in a straight line from R-1004 (≈ 60 m by a pipe route), not ≈ 20–30 m as stated, and a gravity feed over that distance and across the south rack was not feasible. D-MDL-03 (QFL instruction 2026-09-30, carried out as model engineer): T-1001 / P-1004 (NaOH, D-A1000-05), T-1004 / P-1001 (HCl trim), P-1006 / P-1007 / P-1008 (stage transfers) and P-1010 (centrifuge bypass, D-A1000-06) are removed with their pipework, valves, vents, drains, panels and bunds BND-1006 / BND-1009; the stage transfers are replaced by the approved gravity cascade R-1001 → R-1002 → R-1003 → R-1004 (falls 1.1 / 0.9 / 0.8 m on the model envelopes). The retired A-2000 backwash return to T-1006 is re-routed through the A-1000 north utility corridor, the lime / BaCl₂ / floc dosing lines run north first, and the R-1002 / R-1003 / A-500 wet-vent drops move to lanes clear of the south strip — rack S049 and the A-1000 racks S133 / S134 leave the south strip. CL-1001 (Ø 6.5 m) now sits at (41.75, −22.75), ≈ 17 m from R-1004 beside DC-1001 and T-1008; SL-1001 (200 m³, Ø 4.5 m, ≈ 15.6 m tall) at (18, −24.5), ≈ 9 m from T-1002, clear of every overhead line. Both positions were confirmed clear on the rebuilt model (0.5 m / 0.3 m clearance, walkways and overhead). T-1007 / P-1011 remain (in service under Route 0, D-MDL-02). The south-east yard now holds only the A-1100 option set (Route 2 + 6) and its Route 0 reservation. Current model: 287 holds plant-wide.
